note: bitfieldTextTableMaskFirst is allowed only for BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE on the first side.
bitfieldTextTableMaskSecond is allowed only for BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE on the second side.
When both sides are BITFIELD_TEXTTABLE and valuePair exists, identicalMapping must be false.
Every directional value must satisfy the applicable bit mask.
SenderReceiverAnnotation is legal only on a port resolved to SenderReceiverInterface.
ClientServerAnnotation is legal only on a port resolved to ClientServerInterface.
IoHwAbstractionServerAnnotation is permitted for interface kinds other than NvDataInterface.
ParameterPortAnnotation requires a P port owned by ParameterSwComponentType.
ModePortAnnotation requires a port typed by ModeSwitchInterface.
TriggerPortAnnotation requires a port typed by TriggerInterface.
NvDataPortAnnotation requires a port typed by NvDataInterface.
Check signalFan single/nfold annotation against effective inner connector multiplicity.
DelegatedPortAnnotation is legal only on a composition-owned surface port.
A P port may have at most one ComSpec per referenced data element or operation.
An R port may have at most one ComSpec per referenced data element or operation.
